Hello, we are Stamford Bridge Singers

We are a four-part choir of men and women singing soprano, alto, tenor and bass. We are a very friendly bunch of people, with ages ranging right across the spectrum.

We perform at various venues around the York area, with three to five concerts and services a year: church services, Christmas events, local concerts and weddings. Invitations to sing at York Minster are readily accepted.

Some choirs are focused on singing music of a specific genre, but what we sing is so varied: songs from the shows, an amazing range of church and sacred music, local folk music, ballads, our own arrangements of pop songs, the odd Mass and just great music.

Subscriptions are £30 a term, or £90 for the year.

Come to a rehearsal

Tell us a little about you and we will be in touch.

Or contact [NAME] on [EMAIL OR PHONE].

Singing is good for you.

Joining a local choir offers a powerful blend of physical, mental and social benefits that can significantly boost your overall well-being.
